title.narrative: EASTERN PROVINCE JURISDICTIONAL SUSTAINABLE LANDSCAPE PROGRAM - EMISSIONS REDUCTION PROJECT

description.narrative: To generate payments to the Program Entity for (i) measured, reported, and verified Emission Reductions (ERs) from reduced deforestation, forest degradation, enhancement of forest carbon stocks (REDD+), agriculture, and other land use sectors, and to distribute the payments in accordance with an agreed Benefit Sharing Plan (BSP).
